notes.title: Update R1 | Fixes
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just released an update for Fall Of The MS Estonia.

[h1]Fixes and additions[/h1]

-The ship's animation has been updated so now it sinks stern first not bow (for accuracy purposes)

-Pressing "H" hides the timeline at the bottom of the screen (you can still manually press the icon to do this as well)

If you are enjoying the experience please consider leaving a review. It helps us a lot!

[h3]Interactive Gaming Studios[/h3]

notes.title: Released!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We are very excited to announce that Fall Of The MS Estonia has been released! A 15% discount is being applied for the first 2 weeks as well. Experience what happened on that ill-fated day of 28th September 1994.

Any bugs or issues with the game please use this thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2848550/discussions/0/599638172337455273/

We hope you enjoy the experience! If so, please leave a review as it helps a lot!

notes.title: Pre-Release Update 2 | Version 1.2
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We are pleased to announce another pre-release update for Fall Of The MS Estonia! The changes are listed below.

[h1]Changes/additions:[/h1]

-The animation has been revamped. Previously the ship was sailing at an extremely fast unrealistic rate which has now been rectified

-The addition of a new timeline feature. This allows you to go back/forward to any part of the simulation with ease! The timeline can also be hidden from view so it doesn't obstruct your experience (by pressing the left icon)

Timeline shown:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947856/d137bc21a6a799e682c4cda610906adc2fda2149.png[/img]

Timeline Hidden:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947856/6852a4e440f689272be16cc277e72b5346a19852.png[/img]

If you are looking forward to the game please wishlist it! It helps alot! The game is planning to be released next week!

notes.title: Patch Release | Version 1.1
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just released our first pre-release patch/update! All the changes are detailed below.

[h2]Additions and fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]The informational loading screen now displays all of the MS Estonia's history in the same box, and the smoke is correctly aligned with the funnel
[*]The pause menu exit options now are both the same font size
[*]In the daytime explore mode, if you jump/fall off the ship you are automatically re-spawned on the ship
[*]Previously there were white dots affecting the MS Estonia logo - this has now been corrected
[*]The ship's propeller speed has been adjusted so it is more realistic
[/list]

If you are excited about the upcoming release of the game, remember to wishlist it and tell others!

[h3]Interactive Gaming Studios[/h3]
